definitions.val_loss: standardised MSE averaged over all validation rows (1 kHz) and the 9 outputs (the early-stopping loss)
definitions.nrmse: RMSE / pooled training-row label std (the model's y_scale)
definitions.classes: align, drive, orient = phase code before nav_done; reach_move = nav_done up to and including the first step with EE error < 10 mm; reach_hold = after it
definitions.events: start (step 0) and changes of the phase code (nav_done = reach): start, align>drive, drive>orient, drive>reach, orient>reach; other transitions are counted in counts.other_events and get no window
definitions.copycat: measured (v_mes, w_mes) = bc_features.wheels_to_vw(qd_mes[0:4]) as the prediction of (v, w)
definitions.torque_segments: nav_hold = before nav_done, reach_move, reach_hold; z split at analyze_dataset.Z_SPLIT
definitions.lag: signed k in -30..30 minimising the pooled squared error between pred[t] and label[t - k] (k > 0: the prediction lags) over the same steps t for every k, the [event - 20 ms, event + settle] windows of the clean episodes; see lag_definition

lag_definition: lag.<event>: n_events = events of that type in the clean validation episodes; lags = the searched k, -30..30 steps (1 ms each); n_pairs = number of steps t pooled, the same for every k (n_pairs_lag0 = n_pairs, kept for older readers); t runs over the [event - 20 ms, event + settle] windows clipped to the episode. <model|copycat>.<v|w>: mse[i] = pooled MSE between pred[t] and label[t - lags[i]], the label padded with 0 before step 0 (robot at rest) and with its last value after the episode end; k_best = the minimising k, signed: k > 0 the prediction lags the label (pred[t] ~ label[t - k]), k < 0 it leads (exact ties: smallest |k|, then k < 0); mse_best = minimum of the curve; mse_k0 = MSE at k = 0; rel_range = (max - min) / min of the curve (null when min = 0 < max); flat = rel_range < 0.001: no identifiable lag, k_best null; boundary = |k_best| = 30: the true minimum may lie outside the searched range; without events k_best, mse_best, mse_k0 and rel_range are null and both flags false
